name: boAt
desc: Indian consumer electronics brand selling earphones, headphones, speakers and smartwatches, owned by Imagine Marketing, which has filed for an IPO.

name: Autoland AG
desc: Founder-led, manufacturer-independent German car retailer selling about 60,000 vehicles a year from 37 locations in ten federal states.

name: HKS
desc: Dallas privately held architecture firm founded in 1939, designer of SoFi Stadium, AT&T Stadium and Lucas Oil Stadium, with offices in the US, Mexico, India, UAE, Brazil and China.

name: Applegreen
desc: Dublin-based operator of about 620 petrol stations and motorway service areas in Ireland, the UK (Welcome Break) and the United States.

name: P&I Personal & Informatik
desc: German HR and payroll software company serving about 15,000 end customers across German-speaking and southern Europe.

name: Graybar
desc: Employee-owned North American distributor of electrical, communications and data networking products and related supply chain services.

name: J Murphy & Sons
desc: Family-run London civil-engineering contractor working on energy, water, rail and infrastructure projects in the UK and Ireland, with about 3,900 staff.

name: Cofidis
desc: French consumer-credit specialist owned by Crédit Mutuel, selling personal loans in nine European countries and owning a cycling team.

name: Bitzer
desc: Sindelfingen maker of reciprocating, screw and scroll compressors, heat exchangers and pressure vessels for refrigeration and air conditioning.

name: Eko-Okna
desc: Polish manufacturer of PVC and aluminium windows, doors and facades, one of Europe's largest window makers, owned by founder Mateusz Kłosek.

name: 4F
desc: Polish sportswear brand of OTCF S.A., Kraków, selling through about 248 own stores and in 42 countries, and outfitting national Olympic teams.

name: Nuxe
desc: French skincare brand known for Huile Prodigieuse, majority-owned by founder Aliza Jabès's family, sold in about 50 countries with branded spas.

name: Amaris Consulting
desc: Consulting firm created in 2007, part of Mantu, with about 7,600 people in more than 60 countries serving 1,000+ clients.

name: Bauducco
desc: Brazilian family-owned bakery-products maker, the world's largest panettone producer, also leading in toasts, wafers and cookies, exporting to 40+ countries.

name: Sézane
desc: Parisian digital-native womenswear brand, founder-led since 2013, selling mostly online plus own stores in France, London and US cities.

name: OakNorth
desc: London-based digital bank lending to growing small and mid-sized businesses in the UK and, increasingly, the United States.

name: Union Bancaire Privée (UBP)
desc: Family-owned Swiss private bank providing wealth management and asset management to private and institutional clients from about thirty locations.

name: XCL Education
desc: South-East Asian operator of international K-12 schools and preschools, including XCL World Academy Singapore and American School of Bangkok Sukhumvit.

name: Multivac
desc: Allgäu maker of thermoforming packaging machines, traysealers, slicers, portioners, labelling and inspection systems for food, medical and industrial packaging.

name: Troutman Pepper Locke
desc: US full-service law firm formed by the January 2025 merger of Troutman Pepper and Locke Lord, strong in energy, insurance and finance.

name: Club Med
desc: French premium all-inclusive resort operator with about 60 resorts in some 26 countries, controlled by China's Fosun since 2015.

name: Australian Retirement Trust
desc: Australia's second-largest superannuation fund, formed in 2022 from Sunsuper and QSuper, managing retirement savings for over 2.4 million members.

name: Virgin Voyages
desc: Adults-only cruise line operating four ships from US and European ports, jointly owned by Virgin Group and Bain Capital.

name: Traveloka
desc: Southeast Asian online travel platform selling flights, hotels and experiences, founded in Jakarta and operating across eight Asia-Pacific markets.

name: QTS Data Centers
desc: Blackstone-owned developer and operator of hyperscale and wholesale data centres with 28 locations across the US and Netherlands.

name: Bancomat
desc: Rome company, founded 1983, running Italy's Bancomat and PagoBancomat debit networks and Bancomat Pay, owned by Fondo FSI and Italian banks.

name: Suntory Holdings
desc: Family-controlled Japanese drinks group making whisky, spirits, beer and soft drinks, including Yamazaki, Hibiki, Maker's Mark, Lucozade and Boss Coffee.

name: Magenta Telekom
desc: Austrian mobile, broadband and TV operator, a Deutsche Telekom subsidiary with 6.6 million SIM cards and 1.1 million broadband customers.

name: SHV Holdings
desc: Family-owned Dutch holding group running LPG distribution, heavy lifting, animal nutrition, testing and inspection, wholesale and private equity businesses.

name: Robeco
desc: Rotterdam-based asset manager owned by ORIX, known for quantitative and sustainable investing, with offices in twelve countries.

name: Scan Global Logistics
desc: Danish freight forwarder providing air, ocean, road and contract logistics through branches in 61 countries on six continents.

name: Winvic
desc: Privately owned UK main contractor founded in 2001, building logistics, industrial, data-centre and residential schemes, with new director shareholders added.

name: Turner Construction
desc: New York-based US construction company founded in 1902 and owned by Germany's Hochtief, with 46 US offices and about 15,000 employees.

name: Future Electronics
desc: Canadian distributor of electronic components with 170 offices in 44 countries, acquired in 2024 by Taiwan's WT Microelectronics for USD 3.8 billion.

name: AustralianSuper
desc: Australia's largest industry superannuation fund, managing retirement savings for about 3.5 million members, with a trustee owned by unions and employers.

name: ALTANA
desc: German specialty-chemicals group with BYK additives, ECKART effect pigments, ELANTAS insulation and ACTEGA packaging coatings, controlled by Susanne Klatten.

name: L.S. Starrett Company
desc: Manufactures precision hand tools, gauges, metrology systems and saw blades sold to industrial, professional and consumer users in over 100 countries.

name: Knapp
desc: Austrian provider of warehouse automation, order-picking robots, conveyors and logistics software for retail, pharma and e-commerce.

name: Hostplus
desc: Australian industry superannuation fund for hospitality, tourism, recreation and sport workers, with about 2.1 million members.

name: Weidmüller
desc: German manufacturer of electrical connectivity, terminal blocks, industrial electronics and automation software for machine builders and energy markets.
